# Mixtli

> Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Mixtli is Aztec for cloud. The menu drifts to a new corner of Mexico each season.

- Phone: (726) 238-1046

- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: The tasting menu; Wine, cocktail and mocktail pairings; The sweet finish
